items.description: 初步確認候選人背景與 Google Cloud 職缺的適配度，重點在於 GCP 經驗與全端技術棧的結合。｜Initial check on fit between candidate background and the Google Cloud role, focusing on the intersection of GCP experience and full-stack skills.

items.t: 技術電訪：演算法與資料結構 / Technical Phone Screen (Coding)
items.description: 標準的 Google 演算法關卡，測試基礎程式邏輯與解題能力（Python/JS）。｜Standard Google algorithmic round testing fundamental logic and problem-solving skills (Python/JS).

items.t: 現場面試：進階編碼能力 / Onsite: Advanced Coding & DSA
items.description: 深入測試陣列、字串、圖論或動態規劃，並要求撰寫乾淨且高效的程式碼。｜Deep dive into arrays, strings, graphs, or DP, requiring clean and efficient code production.

items.t: 系統程式設計與除錯 / Systems Programming & Debugging
items.description: 針對 JD 強調的「診斷與工具」，測試 Linux 環境下的除錯、記憶體管理與系統互動能力。｜Targeting the JD's focus on 'Diagnostics & Tools', testing debugging, memory management, and system interaction in a Linux environment.

items.t: 前端與內部工具開發 / Front-end & Internal Tools
items.description: 結合履歷的 React 強項與 JD 的工具屬性，設計供資料中心使用的視覺化儀表板或操作介面。｜Leveraging React skills for the JD's 'Tools' aspect, designing visualization dashboards or control UIs for data centers.

items.t: 系統設計：診斷基礎設施 / System Design: Diagnostic Infrastructure
items.description: 設計大規模分散式診斷系統，涵蓋資料蒐集、日誌處理與高可用性架構。｜Designing large-scale distributed diagnostic systems, covering data collection, log processing, and HA architecture.

items.t: 雲端架構與 GCP 實務 / Cloud Architecture & GCP Practice
items.description: 驗證 Google Cloud Architect 認證實力，探討 GCP 服務整合、自動化與資源管理。｜Validating the Google Cloud Architect certification, discussing GCP service integration, automation, and resource management.

items.t: DevOps 與自動化流程 / DevOps, CI/CD & Automation
items.description: 針對 JD 的「自動化」需求，討論 CI/CD 流水線、Docker 容器化與基礎設施即程式碼 (IaC)。｜Addressing the JD's 'automation' requirement, discussing CI/CD pipelines, Docker containerization, and IaC.

items.t: 行為面試：領導力與 Googleyness / Behavioral: Leadership & Googleyness
items.description: 評估在模糊情境下的決策力、跨團隊合作以及是否具備 Google 文化契合度。｜Assessing decision-making in ambiguity, cross-team collaboration, and cultural fit (Googleyness).

items.t: 向面試官提問 / Questions for Interviewers
items.description: 展現對 Google Cloud 硬體與軟體整合領域的熱忱與深度洞察。｜Demonstrating enthusiasm and deep insight into the intersection of Google Cloud hardware and software.
根據該 JD 與履歷所設計的整體應試策略與重點總覽。
